purpose: MO-Parse retro document-terminal variants based on the earlier pale-screen mascot preferred by the user

reference.role: Earlier MO-Parse icon; shape family and understated face reference

known_limitations: Raw generated alpha edges contain fragments; these are design candidates rather than cleaned production masters.

variants.label: 方正经典款
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a new MO-Parse document-terminal mascot icon variant, evolving the supplied earlier icon.
Input image role: the supplied image is the ORIGINAL MO-Parse design reference and family identity to develop further. Preserve the appealing retro little document-reading appliance character. The user prefers this earlier electronic companion direction.
Core visual identity: a softly rounded solid retro terminal enclosure, large calm PALE display with generous empty space, two TINY dark round dot eyes and a THIN short understated smile; one small amber functional button; one modest document emerging from a top reading slot. The document has two broad quiet content strokes and a small simple table motif, no lettering. Character comes from proportions, gently softened geometry and the restrained little expression.
Required family resemblance: it must look like a revised member of this same reference design family, with a paper-reading function, not a new stationery-object creature. Keep the face markings small, calm and graphically precise. Do not replace them with giant pill eyes, shiny pupils or a thick glowing grin. Give the case coherent physical construction, enough visible side depth, and stable support beneath its full rear as well as front.
Medium: polished stylized product-icon rendering with attractive soft highlights and carefully modeled rounded edges. Surface finish and colors may vary between concepts; no blue-only or matte-3D-print requirement, no printed-layer texture needed. Avoid excessive reflections that obscure the calm face.
Composition: one complete device only, square canvas, near-front three-quarter view, visible front and right side, about 80 percent canvas occupancy, all body supports visible, clean generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency. Remove and do not reproduce ANY stray white specks, colored edge fragments, floating pixels or paper-edge debris from the reference. No floor, ground shadow, backdrop, pedestal, app tile, labels or watermark.
Avoid: separate robot head, personified paper sheet or folder, many decorative controls, clutter, disconnected machine parts, giant eyes, loud grin, floating bottom support, extra characters, wordmark. Maintain an independently designed document-appliance character rather than a literal copy of an existing fictional console character.

Variant: CLASSIC COMPACT SQUARE.
Make the referenced terminal slightly more compact and nearly square in its main front face: a broad rounded cube with controlled corner radii, a large pale mint display filling about two thirds of its front height, and a shallower lower chin than the source. Use a warm desaturated turquoise / deep teal casing with ivory screen and paper. Screen has tiny wide-set dark dot eyes and one thin small smile, ample blank space.
One amber button at bottom right and a single narrow dark reading slot across the lower left; REMOVE the extra round white indicator. Show one short folded-corner source page in the top slot, with exposed paper height about one quarter of case height. Replace separate bulbous feet with a low continuous inset dark bottom rim supporting full depth, subtle enough not to look like a pedestal. NO arms or character legs. Keep it close to the source but more resolved, compact and elegant.

Variant: GENTLE WEDGE RETRO WORKSTATION.

The wedge should be subtle and inviting, not an aggressive angular gaming device. Use an elegant warm cream main case with a muted teal upper reading lip and dark petrol inset base, plus one tiny amber button.
A large pale mint-green screen is integrated into the sloping front; tiny dark round dot eyes and a thin modest smile create the whole expression. One cohesive memorable terminal shape, carefully resolved case seams and soft highlights, no sprawling keyboard, no cables, no scenery.
